Introducing Saved Views, available today for all customers. Tired of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a project? Now you can capture any configuration — filters, grouping, sorting, and column setup — as a Saved View, and return to exactly the setup you need with one click.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team member on a paid workspace can start using it right away. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, sprint, or personal workflow. Need your teammates looking at the same data the same way? Views can be shared with a team, so everyone works from a consistent, unified perspective without repeating setup steps.

Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific sprint, or building a custom dashboard for stakeholders, Saved Views helps your team stay aligned and move faster. We think it'll quickly become part of your daily routine.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
